strings.error_overdueby_abovevalue: The overdue amount must be greater than the amount for the rule above ({$a}).
strings.error_overdueby_maxvalue: The overdue amount cannot be greater than {$a}.
strings.error_overdueby_minvalue: The overdue amount must be greater than or equal to {$a}.
strings.error_penalty_abovevalue: The penalty must be greater than the penalty for the rule above ({$a}%).
strings.error_penalty_maxvalue: The penalty cannot be greater than {$a}%.
strings.error_penalty_minvalue: The penalty must be greater than or equal to {$a}%.
strings.finalpenaltyrule_help: The final penalty rule specifies the penalty that is applied to submissions overdue longer than for any other penalty rule.
strings.overdueby_help: The time in seconds after the due date that the penalty will be applied.
strings.penalty_help: The penalty in percent that will be applied for late submissions.
strings.penaltyrule_inherited: The penalty rules in this context are inherited from a parent context. Click Edit to override the values.
strings.penaltyrule_not_inherited: Click Edit to change or add rules.
strings.penaltyrule_overridden: The penalty rules are overridden. Click Reset to remove overridden rules. This will remove all rules if there is no rule in the parent context.
strings.resetconfirm: This will remove all rules in this context. Are you sure you want to continue?
